verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party organization plugin manages organizations, members, teams, roles and permissions. The homepage advertises "Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control," and a community user reports getting organizations and multi-tenancy working with included plugins and no special code. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of invitation flow mechanics (sending, accepting, expiring invitations) beyond a homepage tagline, and independent corroboration specifically of invitations.
